territory.intro: Taiwan cut into hexagons. Click a cell to see everything about that patch of land. Cells get bigger as you zoom out.
territory.tagHint: Pick a tag to color cells by score
territory.legendGrayBase: Gray cells = no tag or attribute selected
territory.legendNoBreaks: All values are the same at this level; no classes
territory.legendNoStatsAtRes: No data for this attribute at this zoom. Zoom out (bigger cells) to see it.
territory.legendZeroSplit: Most cells are 0: zero is its own class, the rest are graded low to high
territory.zoomOut: No data at this zoom — zoom out
territory.bizNone: No registered companies in this cell
territory.villageValueNote: Village value = the statistic of the village the cell sits in; all cells in one village share it
territory.score.response.label: Response
territory.score.response.blurb: How close the nearest fire and police stations are (straight-line)
territory.score.wealth.label: Wealth
territory.score.wealth.blurb: Where this land's home sale price per m² ranks in Taiwan
territory.score.wealth.blurbCounty: Where this land's home sale price per m² ranks in its county
territory.score.convenience.label: Convenience
territory.score.convenience.blurb: How many schools, clinics, convenience stores and stations are nearby
